info.title: Umbraco SBOM Tool
info.description: Generate a CycloneDX 1.6 XML SBOM for a NuGet, npm, Python, or Terraform project. Drop-in replacement for the dotnet CycloneDX and @cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm tools used in CI pipelines, with layered license resolution (registry metadata → maintained override list) and an embedded SPDX license-override list curated for Umbraco's dependency surface (System.*, Microsoft.Extensions.*, hashicorp/*, …).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Generate a CycloneDX 1.6 XML SBOM for a NuGet, npm, Python, or Terraform project.

commands.name: merge
commands.description: Merge several SBOMs into one (see 'umbraco-sbom merge --help').

options.name: --output-file
options.description: Where to write the merged SBOM. Default: ./sbom.xml

options.name: --project-name
options.description: Name the merged project instead of using the first input's.

options.name: --output-file
options.description:
Path where the SBOM file is written. Default: ./sbom.xml
in the current working directory.

options.name: --project-type
options.description:
The type of the scanned project, 'library' or 'application'. Written
to the SBOM as the project component, which Dependency-Track uses as
the project's classifier. Default: guessed from the manifest
(executables, web projects, Terraform and most Python projects are applications; private
npm packages too), otherwise library. The SBOM always includes the
dependency graph (direct vs. transitive).

options.name: --version
options.description:
Print the tool version and exit.
License policy:

options.name: --allow-copyleft
options.description: Permit copyleft-category licenses (GPL, LGPL, AGPL, EPL, ...).

options.name: --allow-commercial
options.description:
Permit commercial-category licenses (residual: non-permissive,
non-copyleft, non-first-party).

options.name: --fail-on-unknown
options.description:
Strict gating on unknown licenses (default: lenient — unknowns
are allowed and recorded as policy-decision=allowed-via-unknown).

options.name: --fail-on-maintenance-fee
options.description:
Fail (exit 50) when a package asks for an Open Source Maintenance Fee
(default: they pass and are tagged OSMF in the SBOM). A matching
--allow-package entry exempts a package.

options.name: --allow-package
options.description: Per-package exception (repeatable). Wildcards as in overrides.json.

arguments.name: PROJECT_PATH
arguments.description:
Path to a project file (e.g., a .csproj or package.json) or a
directory containing the project's manifests.
